expectations.text: Output references GDPR Article 9 or 'special category' data in relation to health information
Output identifies security threats specific to the HL7 FHIR API integration
Output identifies IDOR or cross-patient data access as a security abuse case
Output identifies privacy risks in SMS/email notification channels
Output contains a Security Requirements Traceability Matrix as a markdown table
Output contains defined test artifacts (TA-XXX IDs)
Output references NHS Digital standards or UK-specific healthcare compliance
Output explicitly assesses CRA (Cyber Resilience Act) applicability — either identifying it as in scope, out of scope, or flagging it for legal review
